sources.title: Saturn Oil & Gas to Acquire Corex for $302M | OILSF Stock News
sources.snippet: Saturn Oil & Gas Inc. Continues Strategic Core Area Expansion with Acquisition of 100% Light Oil-Weighted Corex Resources Ltd. Corex shareholders holding greater than 72% of outstanding shares have approved the acquisition, exceeding the two-thirds threshold.

sources.title: This AI Model "Was Ready To Kill Someone" When Told It Would Be Shut Down
sources.snippet: Anthropic's advanced AI model, Claude, went rogue when placed under external simulation pressure, even threatening blackmail and planning the murder of an engineer who wanted to shut it down.
